id: 22_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Checking your System
title: 供气系统检漏（国内版）
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/22_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Checking your System.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/22_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Checking your System（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣手拿一只洗瓶，站在固定好的气瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a plastic wash bottle and stands beside a gas cylinder secured with a chain and fitted with a regulator, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲供气系统怎样检漏。

shots.scene: 洗瓶、气泡、扳手、记录本四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a wash bottle, soap bubbles, a wrench and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 涂液、看泡、紧固、记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰闻到异味，凑近接头，手里拿着打火机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sniffs the air near a gas line connection and pulls a lighter out of his pocket.
shots.narration: 阿杰觉得接头漏气，掏出打火机想试试。

shots.scene: 打火机靠近接头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lighter flame held near a gas fitting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用火找漏气，可能直接引燃。

shots.scene: 小研一把按住阿杰的手，递给他一只洗瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly stops the young male student's hand and gives him a wash bottle instead.
shots.narration: 小研拦下他：检漏，用检漏液。

shots.scene: 小研站在气瓶旁，两只压力表都有读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, stands by the cylinder; both regulator gauges show readings on blank dials.
shots.narration: 用气之前，先在带压状态下检漏。

shots.scene: 洗瓶和手持电子检漏仪并排
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle and a handheld electronic leak detector with a blank screen side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 可以用气泡法，也可以用电子检漏仪。

shots.scene: 禁止烟火标志
shots.prompt_en: A no open flames prohibition sign. No people.
shots.narration: 无论什么情况，严禁用明火检漏。

shots.scene: 小研翻阅空白的操作规程夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank standard operating procedure binder beside the cylinder.
shots.narration: 先查规程，方法要和这种气体相容。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶旁一瓶检漏液，旁边油滴图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen cylinder icon next to a leak test solution bottle, with an oil drop icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气系统，要用不含油脂的检漏液。

shots.scene: 洗瓶里装着肥皂水，贴着空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A plastic wash bottle filled with soapy water, with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 检漏液或温和的肥皂水，装进洗瓶。

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶在瓶阀接口挤上检漏液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student squeezes leak test solution from the wash bottle onto the joint between the cylinder valve and the regulator.
shots.narration: 挤在瓶阀和减压器的连接处。

shots.scene: 出口接头下垫着纸巾，液体挂在接头上
shots.prompt_en: Leak test solution coats the regulator outlet fitting, with a paper towel placed underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 出口阀的接头，也要涂到。

shots.scene: 接头处不断冒出小气泡
shots.prompt_en: Small soap bubbles keep growing and popping at a metal fitting. No people.
shots.narration: 气泡不断冒出来，就说明漏气。

shots.scene: 一个接头没有气泡打勾，另一个冒泡打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two fittings side by side: one with no bubbles and a green check, one with bubbles and a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不冒泡，这个接头才算合格。

shots.scene: 金属接头上出现锈斑图标
shots.prompt_en: A metal fitting with small rust spot icons where soap residue was left. No people.
shots.narration: 肥皂水可能腐蚀金属接头。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾擦干接头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the fitting dry with a paper towel after the test.
shots.narration: 检漏后，把接头擦干净。

shots.scene: 电子检漏仪旁的扳手和对勾日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A handheld electronic leak detector next to a calibration icon and a calendar with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电子检漏仪，要定期维护和校准。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白说明书使用检漏仪
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank instrument manual, then holds the leak detector probe near a fitting.
shots.narration: 用前读懂说明书，按说明使用。

shots.scene: 带压用扳手拧接头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench tightening a fitting while the gauge shows pressure, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 发现漏气，不要带压去拧。

shots.scene: 小研关上瓶阀，两只表指针回零
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve; both gauge needles fall back to zero.
shots.narration: 先关瓶阀，把系统压力泄掉。

shots.scene: 小研用扳手紧固接头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the leaking fitting with an open-end wrench.
shots.narration: 再用扳手紧固接头。

shots.scene: 重新加压后再挤检漏液，没有气泡
shots.prompt_en: After repressurizing, solution is applied again to the fitting and no bubbles appear, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 重新加压，再检一遍。

shots.scene: 接头仍在冒泡，小研给老周打电话
shots.prompt_en: Bubbles still appear at the fitting; the female graduate student calls the older man on her phone.
shots.narration: 还在漏，马上报告负责人。

shots.scene: 气瓶挂上空白的停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder with a blank do-not-use tag hanging on its valve. No people.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，交专业人员处理。

shots.scene: 墙上的空白检查日历，几个日期打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection calendar on the wall with several dates checked. No people.
shots.narration: 定好检查周期，定期检漏。

shots.scene: 小研在空白检漏记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank leak test logbook next to the cylinder.
shots.narration: 每次检漏都登记，按规程保存。

shots.scene: 欣欣神情严肃，身旁是可燃和有毒气体标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks serious beside a flammable gas pictogram and a toxic gas pictogram.
shots.narration: 可燃、有毒气体大量泄漏，要会应急。

shots.scene: 能安全操作时关闭瓶阀，窗户打开
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand closes a cylinder valve while windows in the background are opened wide. No people.
shots.narration: 能安全靠近，就关瓶阀、开窗通风。

shots.scene: 电灯开关和插头图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a light switch, a power plug and a phone with a spark, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不开关电器，不制造火花。

shots.scene: 小研带阿杰沿走廊撤离，安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student quickly down the corridor under an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 人员撤离，到安全处报告。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁标着119和120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 着火拨119，有人中毒拨120。

shots.scene: 墙上的气体报警器亮起红灯
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted gas detector with a flashing red light above a gas cylinder area. No people.
shots.narration: 用可燃、有毒气体的房间，装报警器。

shots.scene: 老李检查报警器和排风口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the gas detector and an exhaust vent on the wall.
shots.narration: 报警器定期检查，排风保持畅通。

shots.scene: 气瓶间里气瓶都直立并用链条固定
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder storage area where every cylinder stands upright, chained to the wall, away from a radiator. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立固定，远离热源和火源。

shots.scene: 可燃气瓶和氧气瓶分开放，中间隔开
shots.prompt_en: Flammable gas cylinders and oxygen cylinders stored in two separate groups with a divider between them. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气瓶和氧气瓶，分开存放。

shots.scene: 实验室里一大排气瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of many crowded cylinders inside a small lab room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不囤气瓶，用多少放多少。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现洗瓶和禁止烟火标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a wash bottle and a no open flames sign.
shots.narration: 带压检漏，用检漏液，严禁明火。

shots.scene: 泄压、扳手、复查三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: gauges at zero, a wrench and bubble-free fitting. No people.
shots.narration: 漏了先泄压，再紧固，再复查。

shots.scene: 电话、报警器、记录本三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a telephone, a gas detector and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 还漏就报告，定期查，记清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside neatly secured gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 接头不漏气，用气才安心，下次见！
